dedupe_keys.name: power curve verification in complex terrain using multi range nacelle lidars

description: Rozenn Wagner and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed UniTTe evaluation uses three measurement campaigns, one in flat terrain and two in complex terrain, to examine nacelle-lidar measurements and induction correction. The case documents the application of these corrections in wind-turbine assessment. It does not establish equal accuracy at every terrain type or identity with a separately described Scottish farm study. The source does not prove that all underlying raw measurements and detailed correction implementations are openly distributed. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
